title: Design teams that still ship
subtitle: User research that changes direction, a design system product managers can build with, and AI in product and practice

cv.label: Download CV (PDF)
cv.note: Tailored for the Senior Manager, User Experience (Quick Commerce) role

bio.short: I've led design teams since 2016 and I still ship. At Ninox I led five designers and UX writers from the Senior Leadership Team, and for four months two functions with nine reports. Today I prototype a consumer streaming app in real code that external engineering ships from, and I helped drive Bibel TV's AI transformation.
bio.long:
At Ninox I led five product designers and UX writers, including a design lead, as a member of the Senior Leadership Team. I hired two and promoted two. I wrote the team's levelling framework and ran performance reviews, growth plans and a lean 360 workshop. For four months I also ran product: three product managers and a data scientist reported to me alongside the design team. Before that I led the UX team at Datameer across Germany and New York for five years. There I opened research access inside regulated banks and insurers.

At Bibel TV I lead product design for a consumer streaming app across iOS, Android, web and connected TV. There are no staff designers, so product managers and product owners shape features themselves. I built a platform-agnostic design-token API with Storybook and automated checks. They build with the real system, and the standard holds without me reviewing every change. I prototype in real code against production APIs, and external engineering ships from that code. I introduced agentic prototyping across the team and shipped a human-operated support copilot and an end-to-end AI fundraising workflow.

The habit that runs through all of it is carrying user evidence into rooms where intuition points the other way. Spreadshirt was a marketplace with about 5,000 business sellers and hundreds of thousands of consumers. Shop-owner interviews and one mobile prototype moved leadership off a 60-second automated journey after two earlier redesigns had failed. The prototype went to production. At ChurchDesk I held product management and all product design. Recurring validation with the client lead, pastors and funeral directors produced a booking capability that cut coordination time 70% and reached 90% acceptance. It shipped to the whole customer base. German native, English C2.

context.emphasis: Lead with the people-leadership record (five reports, nine across two functions, hiring, promotions, levelling framework) paired with hands-on AI work in both product and practice. Make research-into-decisions the through-line, with Spreadshirt as the consumer evidence. Show design-system implementation as capability that lets non-designers build within the standard.
